mechanic: Find the shared symbol within 4.5 seconds. The user may press only ONE icon per round; wrong picks leave the point to the bot and deal the next cards. A 4.5-second timeout lets the bot take it, and a correct question steals that point.
questionCountNote: 50 unique questions per level. A round only ever moves forward through them: losing, answering wrong, or pressing Play again continues at the next unseen question, so the pool must outlast many rounds.
distractorRules: Wrong options must be the same kind of thing as the right one — same units, same part of speech, same level of detail, similar length. No option may be identifiable by its shape or position; each must be a mistake somebody at this level would actually make.
